"Config 10 | 3-row Addition (extra curriculum)", "value": "60%"}, {"label": "Config 10 | Single Digit Multiplication", "value": "0%"}]}, "table_summary": "This ablation table reports task success rates (%) for a neural-network RL controller (Neural Turing Machine style, ICLR 2016) as memory units, discount factor, Watkins Q(λ), task penalty, and test length are varied. Adding Watkins Q(λ) with adaptive discounting (γ=D) is the decisive factor: only then do Reverse (with FF controller), Walk, 2-row Addition and Single Digit Multiplication become solvable, with 100% success on Copying, Walk (FF), and 2-row Addition for the best config (200 units, γ=D, Q(λ)=✓, task penalty ✓). 3-row Addition is never solved from scratch (0% in all configs) and degrades at longer test length (1000), while the extra-curriculum variant reaches up to 80%."}
